Container.Name: MediaCache
Container.Overview:
MediaCache moves what you are about to watch onto your cache drive, so the array can stay spun down, and moves watched media back afterwards.
Works with Plex, or Jellyfin (experimental): - Plex: OnDeck and Watchlist for you and other users. - Jellyfin: Continue Watching and Next Up as OnDeck, Favorites as Watchlist. Web UI on port 5757 with a setup wizard, scheduling, notifications and cache management.
MOVER INTEGRATION (optional): if you use the CA Mover Tuning plugin, set its exclude file to the unraid_mover_exclusions.txt in this container's Config folder.
Migrating from PlexCache-D: stop it and set Config to its existing appdata folder (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/plexcache). Settings, tracking and mover exclusions carry over.
A fork of PlexCache-D by StudioNirin (github.com/StudioNirin/PlexCache-D).
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server or Jellyfin (10.9+) reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Path: Config
Config.Description: Settings, logs, tracking data and the mover exclude list. Migrating from PlexCache-D? Point this at its existing appdata folder.

Config.Name: Path: Cache
Config.Description: Your cache drive, where media gets cached.

Config.Name: Path: Array
Config.Description: Direct array access (user0), for moving files back and for .plexcached backups.

Config.Name: Path: User shares
Config.Description: User shares, for resolving your media server's library paths.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (100 = users on Unraid).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps and scheduling.

Config.Name: Path: Unraid notify script
Config.Description: Unraid's notify script, for native Unraid notifications. Optional.

Config.Name: Path: Unraid notifications
Config.Description: Unraid's notification queue, for native Unraid notifications. Optional.
